gates.requirement: User, job, context, measurable outcome, risk, and non-goals are explicit.
Entry surfaces and page-sprawl decision are intentional and evidence-backed.
First use, happy path, resume, cancel, undo, partial completion, and recovery are complete.
Night Shift composition, hierarchy, density, type, imagery, mascot role, and semantic color are approved.
Applicable loading, empty, stale, offline, permission, partial, conflict, error, retry, success, and recovery states exist.
Compact through wide layouts plus touch, pointer, keyboard, rotation, safe-area, and multi-window behavior are proven.
English, Persian, RTL, long strings, locale formatting, bidi safety, and text scaling are proven.
Semantics, focus, keyboard, screen reader, target size, contrast, color independence, and cognitive access are proven.
Full, Reduced, and Off motion plus interruption, receipts, fallback, sound, and haptic semantics are proven.
Canonical entities and all shared Data Plane concerns have implementation and evidence.
Authority, access, secrets, consent, sensitive data, retention, abuse, audit, export, and deletion are safe.
Representative budgets, profiler evidence, degradation, memory, battery, and large-data behavior pass.
Contract, unit, migration, integration, visual, accessibility, runtime, and platform evidence is linked.
Independent critique finds no generic, incoherent, duplicative, unsafe, or unearned-page implementation.

statusPolicy.generatorRule: Base generation never marks a capability or gate verified; only the reviewed evidence overlay may advance status, and semantic verification still governs completion.
statusPolicy.verifiedRule: Every required gate and Data Plane concern must be verified with current evidence; not_applicable requires a reviewed rationale and evidence.
